sheet.title: Lay down a white sheet
sheet.body: A plain white sheet on the floor or bed. A clean background lets us cut the piece out sharply and keep its true colours.

flat.title: Lay the piece flat
flat.body: One piece at a time works best. Smooth it out, sleeves to the side, so every seam and detail shows.

straight.title: Shoot straight down
straight.body: Hold the phone flat above the piece and fit all of it in the frame. Angled shots make pieces look a different shape.

light.title: Use good light
light.body: Daylight by a window or a strong lamp. Flash is fine. In dim evening light, dark pieces lose their colours and details.

check.title: {count, plural, one {This photo looks} other {# photos look}} too dark or unclear
check.whyDark: In dim light, dark pieces lose their seams and colours, so the scan may get them wrong (black can come out brown, gold can come out silver).
check.whyUnclear: Blurry or dark photos make the scan guess at colours and details, so it may get pieces wrong.
check.howTo: How to take a good scan photo

privacyConnected.title: Using Styld through ChatGPT or Claude
privacyConnected.data: When you use Styld in an AI host such as ChatGPT or Claude, that host sends the tool requests you choose to Styld. Results can include your selected wardrobe details, board contents, profile information and images needed to display a card. Photos you ask the host to add are copied into your Styld account. Public browsing is available without an account on supported hosts. Styld does not receive your entire conversation through this connection.
privacyConnected.scopes: Linking uses OAuth, so your Styld password is not shared with the host. The consent screen lists the requested permissions: styld:read reads your data and styld:write permits changes and eligible paid actions; identity scopes can provide account identity, and offline_access permits token refresh. Tools that run Styld’s AI retain the membership and credit checks.
privacyConnected.revoke: You can revoke access in Account → Connected agents. Revocation prevents new requests with that grant; it does not erase results already held in the host’s conversation history. The host processes and retains those results under its own privacy policy and account settings. Styld records connection and tool-usage events to operate and improve the service.
